content.description: A memorandum from the North Carolina Department of Revenue, dated June 3, 2008, and addressed to County Assessors regarding an interest rate update. The document is signed by David B. Baker, Director of the Property Tax Division, and mentions an attached memorandum from Secretary of Revenue Reginald S. Hinton concerning interest rates for tax overpayments from July 1, 2008, through December 31, 2008.

This document is a formal memorandum from David B. Baker, Director of the Property Tax Division, regarding an interest rate update for July 1, 2008, through December 31, 2008. The text explains that the provided interest rate applies to the overpayment of taxes resulting from orders by the Property Tax Commission as specified in G.S. 105-290(b)(4).

content.text: FROM: David B. Baker, Director Property Tax Division
Attached is a memorandum from Reginald S. Hinton, Secretary of Revenue, establishing the interest rate for July 1, 2008 through December 31, 2008.

The rate indicated in the memorandum reflects the interest rate to be applied to any overpayment of taxes resulting from an order of the Property Tax Commission that reduces the valuation of property or removes it from the tax lists as provided in G.S. 105-290(b)(4).
If you have any questions concerning this matter, please call our office at (919) 733-7711.

content.description: A memorandum from the North Carolina Department of Revenue, dated June 2, 2008, and signed by Secretary Reginald S. Hinton, announces that the interest rate for tax overpayments and assessments from July 1, 2008, through December 31, 2008, is 5%. The document includes a historical list of previous interest rates dating back to 1996.

cells.text: Employees of the Department of Revenue

Reginald S. Hinton
Secretary of Revenue
Interest Rate for July 1, 2008 through December 31, 2008

content.description: A formal memo from Secretary of Revenue Reginald S. Hinton establishes the interest rate for the period of July 1, 2008, through December 31, 2008, at 5%. The document also includes a list of historical interest rates dating back to 1996 for reference.

content.text: G.S. 105-241.21(a) requires the Secretary to establish interest rates to be in effect during a six-month period beginning January 1 and July 1 on overpayments and assessments of tax.
The interest rate for the period July 1 through December 31, 2008, is 5%. The current rates are shown below:

9% per annum from January 1, 1996 through December 31, 1998
8% per annum from January 1, 1999 through December 31, 2001
6% per annum from January 1, 2002 through June 30, 2003
5% per annum from July 1, 2003 through December 31, 2005
7% per annum from January 1, 2006 through December 31, 2006
8% per annum from January 1, 2007 through June 30, 2007
8% per annum from July 1, 2007 through December 31, 2007
7% per annum from January 1, 2008 through June 30, 2008
5% per annum from July 1, 2008 through December 31, 2008
